messages:
Sara (FinOps): Reminder: reserved GPU renewals due in 12 days. We need a prioritized list of commit recommendations by region/model. Start with per-model daily burn + commitability signal. cc @Jon @Priya

CostBot: daily-finops: total GPU spend $1,245,210/mo; committed cover: 58%; burn trend +4% week-over-week; potential 1yr commit savings (15% shift) = ~$60k/mo

Jon (Infra): Heads-up: us-west1 has extra p4d capacity but egress to eu could increase. eu-west1 limited 3yr availability this quarter. Suggest we prefer 1yr in eu and 3yr in us for stable models.

Priya (ML Infra): For commitability metrics, I'm exporting: sustained_hours_30/60/90, 95p_util, kv_cache_hit, tail_latency_p99. Note: chat-core-13b has sticky KV cache; moving capacity will drop cache_hit ~6% during cutover for ~1-3 hours.

Emma (Eng): Updated the FinOps dashboard: added columns for sustained_hours, kv_cache_hit, quantized_variant_delta (cost%). Query used:
```
SELECT model, route, SUM(cost) as total_cost, AVG(util) as avg_util, SUM(sustained_hours) as sustained
FROM model_billing
WHERE ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 day'
GROUP BY model, route
ORDER BY total_cost DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

Miguel (Product): Prioritization: customer-facing chat (high), search-relevance (med), internal batch jobs (low). If we must trade, keep chat models committed in US/EU. Also need a "user-impact" score for moving to quantized variants (latency/regression risk).

Sara (FinOps): Proposal: optimization score = 0.45*cost_share + 0.30*sustained_util + 0.15*business_priority + 0.10*kv_stability. We'll run sims across (region x model x term) and produce top-20 recommendations. Anyone object?

Jon (Infra): Fine. Also simulate egress delta: moving more capacity west increases cross-region egress by ~0.8c/token for some traffic patterns. Add egress_cost to the sim input.

Priya (ML Infra): CSV attached (will upload): includes model, region, sustained_30/60/90, avg_util, kv_hit, p95_latency. ETA EOD.

CostBot: reservation-sim job queued. Parameter set: shift_options=[10,20,30]% term_options=[1yr,3yr] include_quantization=True include_egress_cost=True

Emma (Eng): Small note: some routes have big diurnal swings. For those, commitability should use 90th-percent util, not mean. I'll flag routes with peak_hours_bias.

Sara (FinOps): Action list: Priya upload CSV (EOD), Jon confirm region capacity + egress note (tomorrow AM), Emma finalize dashboard flags (EOD), Sara run sims Mon AM and present prioritized commit list with expected monthly savings and risk score. Quick sync 09:30 Mon in #finance.

Miguel (Product): Will send business_priority mapping doc before Monday. Also request an additive view showing savings_IF_quantized_only so we can compare committing vs software optim.

Sara (FinOps): Thanks all. If sim shows >8 months ROI for 3yr in a region with capacity risk, we'll downgrade to 1yr. :white_check_mark:

CostBot: links: https://console.redwood/finops/per-model-summary, https://console.redwood/finops/reservation-sim

Jon (Infra): I'll also check partner inventory for p4d in ap-southeast for potential overflow if EU gets constrained.

Sara (FinOps): Perfect. We'll reconvene after sims. :calendar:
